results.title: One Championship: Dangal
results.overview: In the main event, longtime ONE Heavyweight World Champion Brandon Vera defends his belt against surging contender Arjan Bhullar, who is on a historic quest to become the first-ever Indian World Champion in mixed martial arts.  Also on the stacked card, Indian wrestling superstar Ritu Phogat faces veteran striker Bi Nguyen in a classic clash of styles.

results.title: Revenge of the Nerds II: Nerds in Paradise
results.overview: The members of Lambda Lambda Lambda travel to Fort Lauderdale for a fraternity conference. They'll have to fend off the attacks of their rival frat, the Alphas, if they want to maintain their self-respect — and, of course, if they want to get anywhere with the pretty girls!

results.title: Attack on Titan
results.overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. results.title: Attack on Titan: Junior High
results.overview: Your favorite characters from Attack on Titan are back in…junior high school? Adapted from the hit spinoff manga series—Attack on Titan: Junior High (written by Saki Nakagawa), this parody reimagines Eren, Mikasa, Armin, and other characters from the original manga as students and teachers at Titan Junior High School.

results.title: Attack on Titan: Chibi Theater
results.overview: Shingeki no Kyojin Picture Drama is a series of Flash animation shorts included in the Blu-ray Disc/DVD releases, featuring the characters in chibi format. Each episode depicts their training days to become humanity's hope in the war against the Titans.

results.title: Attack on Titan: Counter Rockets
results.overview: The daily lives and secrets of the soldiers of the Scout Regiment.

results.title: The Apothecary Diaries
results.overview: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she's sold as a lowly servant to the emperor's palace. But she wasn't meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!
